γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle

εἰσορόωντες: εἰσοράω — look at, gaze on; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶντες)

θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.

μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a place-name: ’mid-Argos’ · also as an ordinary attributive adjective agreeing with a neuter noun: ’the middle of the sail’ (μέσον ἱστίον) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun after a preposition: ’the middle’ (ἐς μέσον ’into the middle’)
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’) · also μή + subj. standing alone as a warning, ’lest’ (μή τίς τοι … ἀναστῇ ’lest someone rise up against you’) · also μή + fut. indic. in a fear clause: ’lest, I fear’ (μή τίς … νεμεσήσεται ’lest anyone resent’)
μήλων: μῆλον — sheep, small cattle; neut. gen. pl.
μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
μαντεύεσθαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. inf. mid.
μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μενέμεν: μένω — stay, remain; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic μένειν)
μεσόδμαι: μεσόδμη — cross-timber of a house (exact fitting not known; also a ship’s mast-block); fem. nom. pl.
μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic μετεῖπε)
μηκέτι: μηκέτι — no longer, not any more; neg. adv., used with subj./imper. in prohibitions
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μνηστῆρες: μνηστήρ — suitor; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’suitors!’
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’ · also ’lest’ in a warning, + 2 sg. fut./subj.: μὴ … ἀποτίσεαι ’lest you pay for it’ · also + inf., negating an infinitive of advice that gives the content of a word: ’not to’ (ἔπος … μὴ πάντα μνηστῆρσιν ὁμιλεῖν ’a word, not to mingle in everything with the suitors’)
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νέμεσις: νέμεσις — righteous indignation, blame; fem. nom. sg.
νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl.
νέον: νέος — new, young; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’newly, for the first time’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’young’ (νέον ἄνδρα ’a young man’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not a new one’, of a debt) · also adv., ’just now, a moment ago’ (νέον ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’just now than before’; νέον ἦσθα γέρων ’just now you were an old man’)
νέων: νέος — young; masc. gen. pl. · also a different word, νέω ’swim’: pres. part. masc. nom. sg., ’swimming’
νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
ναιεταόντων: ναιετάω — dwell, be situated, be inhabited; pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετώντων)
νηῒ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables)
νοέω: νοέω — perceive, form a judgment, think; pres. 1 sg.
νοστήσειν: νοστέω — return home; fut. inf.: ’will return home’
νόημα: νόημα — thought, notion, idea; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’mind, purpose’ (ἐϋφραίνοιμι νόημα ’gladden the mind’)
νόστιμός: νόστιμος — of a homecoming, destined to return; masc. nom. sg.
ξείνους: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. acc. pl.
ξεῖνον: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); acc. sg.
ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. as exclamatory adv.: ’how!, what a thing!’ (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also causal conj. after a verb of emotion, ’in that, that’ · also correlative ’such as, as’ (οἷον ὅτε πρώτιστον ’such as when first’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τὸν Τηλεφίδην: ’what a man, such a one as’ (ἀλλ’ οἷον … κατενήρατο ’but what a man he slew’) · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’of such a kind as’ (οἷον ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ἄγησι ’such as the day he brings’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’what sort of (strength)’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐδὲν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc./nom. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’ · also neut. nom. sg. as subject: ’nothing’ (οὐδὲν γλύκιον … γίγνεται ’nothing is sweeter’) · also neut. acc. sg. as object of a verb, with a comparative: ’nothing (slighter)’ (οὐδὲν ἀκιδνότερον … γαῖα τρέφει ’the earth nourishes nothing slighter’)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
οὐρανοῦ: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. gen. sg.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔατα: οὖς — ear; neut. acc. pl., epic οὔατα (= Attic ὦτα)
οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’) · also ’before (that)’ with a finite verb, in the past: πάρος δ’ εἰς Ἴλιον ᾤχετο ’before that he went to Ilios’ · also with a participle: ’formerly, before’ (πάρος περ ἐὼν ’though formerly being’)
πάσχετε: πάσχω — suffer, experience; impf. 2 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπάσχετε)
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πίμπλαντο: πίμπλημι — fill; impf. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπίμπλαντο): ’were filled’
πίνων: πίνω — drink; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’drinking’
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena of unknown origin (perhaps πάλλω ’brandish’); nom. sg.
παρέπλαγξεν: παραπλάζω — drive astray, carry past; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove astray’
παρεζόμενος: παρέζομαι — sit down beside; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
πατρώϊα: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, paternal; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic πατρῷα): ’what is one’s father’s’
παχείῃ: παχύς — thick, stout, strong; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic παχείᾳ)
πείραιον: Πείραιος — Peiraeus, son of Clytius, Telemachus’s companion; masc. acc. sg.
πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’ · also epithet of Eurycleia: fem. nom. sg., ’circumspect Eurycleia’
περικαλλέα: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περικαλλῆ) · also neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with a neuter plural noun: ’very beautiful’ (ἔργα ... περικαλλέα ’very beautiful works, fine handiwork’)
πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
πλέον: πλέω — sail; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἔπλεον) · also πλείων — more; neut. acc. sg. (= πλεῖον)
πλείη: πλεῖος — full, + gen.; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic πλέα)
πλεῖστα: πολύς — much, many; superlative πλεῖστος, neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’most, the greatest amount’
πολλούς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
πολύβου: Πόλυβος — Polybus, father of Eurymachus; masc. gen. sg.
πολύφρονα: πολύφρων — of many counsels, much-minded; masc. acc. sg.
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial with a negative: ’far’ (οὐ πολὺ ναῖεν ’did not live far off’)
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’ · also + dat., ’on, upon’: ποτὶ χθονί ’on the ground’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
πρόθυρον: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway; neut. acc. sg.
πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόδα: πούς — foot; also the sheet (the rope that sets a sail); masc. acc. sg.
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’) · also neut. nom. pl., attributive: ’many’ (ἤματα πόλλ’ ’many days’)
πόρῃσιν: πόρω (defective) — give, grant, furnish; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
σίτου: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg.
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ) · also gen. of comparison: σεῖο … μακάρτατος ’more blessed than you’
σιωπῇ: σιωπή — silence; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner: ’in silence’
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στυφελίζετε: στυφελίζω — treat roughly, abuse, buffet; pres. imper. 2 pl., in a prohibition with μήτε
στυφελιζομένους: στυφελίζω — strike roughly, buffet, abuse; pres. part. pass., masc. acc. pl.
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῇ: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also with a noun, neut. acc. pl.: ’these’ (τάδε δώμαθ’ ’this house’, plural for one dwelling)
τάφον: τάφος — funeral rite, funeral feast; masc. acc. sg.
τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεθνάμεν: θνῄσκω — die; perf. inf. ’to be dead’, epic -μεν (= Attic τεθνάναι)
τελέσειεν: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may he bring to pass’ · also potential (with κεν): ’might bring to pass’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in an indirect question after a past verb: ’how he might fulfil’ (ὅππως … τελέσειεν)
τετύκοντο: τεύχω — make, prepare; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic reduplicated aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἐτεύξαντο): ’they prepared’
τηλέμαχ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., elided (Τηλέμαχ’ = Τηλέμαχε)
τηλέμαχον: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τηλεμάχῳ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. dat. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι) · also τοι, the affirming particle, accented τοί before an enclitic: ἀλλ’ ἦ τοί σε ’but truly you’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj. · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: τοῖον … ἔρνος (acc.), τοῖον … δόρυ (nom.) ’such a shoot, such a trunk’
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: masc./neut. dat. pl. ’in which, with which’ (τετυγμένα, τοῖς ἐνάμελγεν ’well-made, in which he milked’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: ’the’ (ἰχθύσι τοῖς ὀλίγοισι ’for the little fishes’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’ · also relative, masc./neut. dat. pl. ’on which’ (κώεα, τοῖσιν ἐνεῦδεν ’the fleeces on which he had slept’)
τοῖχοι: τοῖχος — wall (of a room or house); masc. nom. pl.
τοῖχον: τοῖχος — wall (of a room or house); acc. sg.
τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg.
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’ · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (φάρμακον … τό σφιν πόρε ’the drug which she gave them’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg., subject of its clause: ’which’ (τό κε κέρδιον εἴη ’which would be better’)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τόφρ: τόφρα — so long, during that time; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’as long as’, elided (τόφρ’ = τόφρα)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective, neut.: ’the (worse things)’ (τὰ χέρεια) · also neut. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cow and the goats
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’ · also article-like before the adverb πάροιθε: ’formerly’ (τὸ πάροιθε ’in former times’) · also article-like before an infinitive, which it makes a noun: ’the (keeping watch)’ (τὸ φυλάσσειν)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τῆλ: τῆλε (elided/apocopated τῆλ’) — far, far away; adv.
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’) · also adverbial, with κε: ’in that case, otherwise’ (τῷ κέ μιν … παύσαμεν ’otherwise we should have stopped him’)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
χέρηα: χέρης — worse, inferior; masc. acc. sg., epic (Attic χείρων), + gen. of comparison: ’inferior to’
χαίρων: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rejoicing’
χαλεπαίνοι: χαλεπαίνω — be fierce, rage (of weather); pres. opt. 3 sg., general condition · also be angry, take offence (of a person); pres. opt. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: οὐκ ἂν … χαλεπαίνοι ’no one should take offence’
χαλεπὸν: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous, painful; neut. nom. sg.
ἀέκουσαν: ἄκων (epic ἀέκων) — unwilling; fem. acc. sg. (= Attic ἄκουσαν)
ἀγορεύειν: ἀγορεύω — speak (esp. in assembly); pres. inf.
ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)
ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl., used substantivally: ’unseemly things’ (ἀεικέα μερμηρίζων ’pondering unseemly things’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with πήρην: ’unseemly, shabby (wallet)’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’shameful (deeds)’ (ἀεικέα ἔργ’) · also fem. acc. sg. (one form for masc. and fem.), agreeing with πήρην: ’unseemly’ (ἀεικέα πήρην ’an unseemly wallet’)
ἀεικελίως: ἀεικελίως — unseemly, shamefully; adv. (= Attic ἀεικῶς)
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀκέων: ἀκέων — silent, in silence; adj., masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’silently’
ἀλήτην: ἀλήτης — wanderer, vagrant, beggar; masc. acc. sg.
ἀλεύατο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἠλεύατο): ’avoided’
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.
ἀνέρας: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. pl., epic ἀνέρας (= Attic ἄνδρας)
ἀνέστη: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood up’
ἀναγκαίῳ: ἀναγκαῖος — compelling, of necessity; masc. dat. sg.
ἀναιδέσι: ἀναιδής — shameless (ἀν- + αἰδώς); masc. dat. pl.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’opposite, facing’ (ἀντίον Εὐρυμάχου ’opposite Eurymachus’)
ἀντιβίοις: ἀντίβιος — hostile, face to face, opposing; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσι
ἀντιθέου: ἀντίθεος — godlike, equal to the gods; masc. gen. sg.
ἀντὶ: ἀντί — instead of, in place of; prep. + gen.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀτάσθαλα: ἀτάσθαλος — wanton, reckless; neut. acc. pl., substantive: ’wanton, reckless deeds’, the adjective behind the fixed noun ἀτασθαλίαι ’wanton-follies’
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες) · also = ἀνά as a preposition + acc.: ’up through, up among’ (ἂν δόνακας ’up through the reeds’) · also in ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἂν … ἑλοίμεθα ’so that we might seize’)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄκουεν: ἀκούω — hear, listen to, obey (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουε)
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλφοι: ἀλφάνω — earn, fetch (a price); aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κεν: ’he would earn’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ἵνα, with no κεν: ’may bring in’ (ἵνα μοι βίοτον πολὺν ἄλφοι)
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual pron./adj., used with a dual verb · also with a plural noun: ἄμφω χεῖρας ’both hands’ · also in apposition to a plural subject: ’both of us’ (ἱκόμεθ’ ἄμφω)
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also in ὄφρ’ ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρ’ ἄν ἔχῃς ’so that you may keep’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that anyone … would call you blessed’)
ἄνωγα: ἄνωγα — bid, command, order; perf. 1 sg. with pres. sense: ’I bid’
ἄξιον: ἄξιος — worth, worthy; neut. nom. sg., + gen.: ’worth (a return)’ · also ἄξιος — worth, worthy; masc. acc. sg., attributive: ’a worthy (price)’ (ἄξιον ὦνον)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἄσβεστον: ἄσβεστος — unquenchable, inextinguishable (ἀ- + σβέννυμι); adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (ἄσβεστον κλέος ’fame unquenchable’)
ἄσπετα: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, untold, unutterable; neut. nom. pl.
ἄχθος: ἄχθος — burden, load, weight; neut. acc. sg.
ἅδοι: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to; aor. opt. 3 sg. (aor. ἅδον), + dat.: ’might please’
ἆ: ἆ — ah!, oh!; interjection of dismay or reproach
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, happen; aor. 3 pl.: ’became, were’ (ὁμηγερέες ἐγένοντο ’were assembled together’) · also ’were born’ (ἠδ’ ἐγένοντο)
ἐθέλῃ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., in an εἰ clause without κε: ’is willing’ · also with κεν in a general relative clause: ’may wish’ (ὅττι κεν ᾧ θυμῷ ἐθέλῃ ’whatever he may wish in his heart’)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’)
ἐμοῖο: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ἐμπάζετο: ἐμπάζομαι — pay heed to, care for (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was heeding’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — here, to this place; adv., with -δε suffix of direction (’in this place’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’) · also + acc., ’in pursuit of, after’ (ἐπ’ ἀγροτέρας ’after wild (goats)’) · also + dat., ’in favour of, on behalf of’ (ἐπ’ Ἴρῳ ἦρα φέρων ’showing favour to Irus’) · also + acc. of time: ’for’ (ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ’for a day’) · also + gen., of place: ’at, on’ (ἐπ’ ἐσχατιῆς ’at the edge’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπιδέδρομεν: ἐπιτρέχω — run over, spread over; perf. 3 sg. (ἐπιδέδρομε(ν), = Attic ἐπιδεδράμηκε)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’) · also + dat., of purpose: ’for’ (ἐπὶ δόρπῳ ’for supper’) · also + dat., of the occasion: ’at, over’ (ἐπὶ ῥηθέντι δικαίῳ ’at a fair remark’)
ἐρυκακέειν: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain, detain; aor. inf., reduplicated epic -κακέειν (= Attic ἐρῦξαι): ’to hold back’
ἐρχόμενον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’as he went’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλά: ἐσθλός — good, noble, excellent; neut. acc. pl.
ἐφήσει: ἐφίημι — send/let loose upon, launch at; fut. 3 sg.
ἑκάστου: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. gen. sg.
ἔβαλες: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you struck’
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was destined, was about to’
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become, happen; aor. 3 sg. used with pres. force: ’is’ · also with ordinary past/aorist force: ’came to be, arose’ (τοῦτο νόημα ἔπλετο ’this thought has arisen’)
ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα) · also ’tilled land, farmed fields’ (Ἰθάκης … ἔργ’)
ἔργων: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. gen. pl.
ἔρχεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. inf.: ’to go’ · also pres. inf. used as imperative: ’go!’ (ἔρχεσθαι δή ’go then’)
ἔσθων: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (ἔσθω)
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφασαν: φημί — say; impf. 3 pl., augmented (cf. unaugmented φάσαν): ’they said’, + acc. and inf.
ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’ · also adjectival, with a noun: ’each piece’ (ὅπλα ἕκαστα) · also neut. nom. pl. in apposition: ’each’ (πεντήκοντα δ’ ἕκαστα ’fifty to each’)
ἕνα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg. (ἕνα θυμόν ’one mind’)
ἠέλιος: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; nom. sg. · also Ἠέλιος, the Sun as a god, Helios: nom. sg.
ἠνίπαπε: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, chide; aor. 2 3 sg., epic reduplicated (ἠνίπαπον, no Attic equivalent)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly’ · also attributive, agreeing with a neut. noun: ’sweet’ (ἡδὺ ποτόν ’sweet drink’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’ · also introducing the first alternative of a deliberation: ’whether … or’ (ἢ ἐλάσει’ … ἦέ μιν ἦκ’ ἐλάσειε) · also ’than’ after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖον … ἢ Ὀδυσῆ’ ’another … than Odysseus’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤπιον: ἤπιος — gentle, kind, mild; masc. acc. sg., predicate with an infinitive: ’kind (to you)’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive with ἄνακτα: ’so kind a master’
ἤσθιον: ἐσθίω — eat; impf. 3 pl.; with κατά in tmesis = κατήσθιον ’were devouring’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦα: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἦα (= Attic ἦν)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’
ἰκαρίοιο: Ἰκάριος — Icarius, father of Penelope; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.; where the metre makes the ι long, that is the augment, which the spelling cannot show; with short ι, unaugmented
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀπάζειν: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, give as a follower; pres. inf. act.
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’) · also article-like with a superlative: ’the worst’ (ὁ κάκιστος Ἀχαιῶν ’the worst of the Achaeans’)
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’) · also + subj. without κε, in a general clause: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε τις μνήσῃ ’whenever anyone mentions’) · also + opt., of what may happen in time to come: ’whenever he should’ (ὁππότε νοστήσειε ’whenever he should come home’) · also + indic., of a recurring case: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε θυμὸς ἄνωγε ’whenever the heart bids’)
ὁράασθαι: ὁράω — see, look upon; pres. inf. mid., uncontracted, diectasis (= Attic ὁρᾶσθαι)
ὁρόωντες: ὁράω — see, look at; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶντες)
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθεν: ὅθεν — from where, whence; relative adv.
ὅνδε: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ὅνδε δόμονδε ’to his own house’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὑβρίζοντες: ὑβρίζω — act violently or insolently, commit outrage (from ὕβρις); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’behaving insolently’
ὑμέων: σύ — you; pl. ὑμεῖς, gen. pl. ὑμέων, epic (= Attic ὑμῶν)
ὑμῖν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; dat. pl.: ’to you’
ὑπέδεκτο: ὑποδέχομαι — undertake, promise, agree to; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented · also ’receive as a host, welcome’ (ὅττι μιν ὣς ὑπέδεκτο ’that he had received him so’) · also ’await, lie in wait for’, of woe awaiting a man (ἔτι γάρ νύ με πῆμ’ ὑπέδεκτο ’for woe still awaited me’); the form is in fact augmented (ὑπ-έ-δεκτο, 2nd aor.)
ὑπεκφύγοι: ὑπεκφεύγω — escape from; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., potential with κέν: ’might escape’ · also optative of wish after μηδ’: ’may he not escape’
ὑπερηνορεόντων: ὑπερηνορέω — play the overbearing man, be overweening (ὑπέρ + ἀνήρ); pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted, partitive with τις · also attributive gen. pl. with a noun: ’over-bold’ (ἀνδρῶν ὑπερηνορεόντων ’of men over-bold’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὔμμιν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; epic dat. pl. ὔμμιν (= Attic ὑμῖν): ’to you’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’ · also introducing a wish with the optative: ’so may…’ (ὣς ἔμ’ ἀϊστώσειαν ’so may they make me vanish’)
ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse, set in motion; aor. 3 sg.: ’stirred up, roused’
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
ῥέζετε: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; pres. 2 pl.
ῥηθέντι: ἐρέω (εἶπον; aor. pass. ἐρρήθην) — say; aor. part. pass. neut. dat. sg.: ’what was said’, with δικαίῳ
ῥυστάζοντας: ῥυστάζω — drag about, handle roughly; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.
